name: hairness/artifacts
description: The generic lifecycle for inspectable Artifacts owned by a Desk, Home or Target.

capabilities.description: Create, inspect, validate and publish source-owned Artifacts.

skills.description: Use when work should become an explicit, inspectable Artifact.

commands.name: create
commands.description: Create an Artifact, optionally importing a directory.

commands.name: list
commands.description: List Artifacts across Desk, Home and bound Targets.

commands.name: validate
commands.description: Validate one Artifact against its owning kind.

commands.name: publish
commands.description: Publish a Desk Artifact to the Home or a Target.
